description: Creates a Timesheet and Timecard Entries in bulk together (DEPRECATED) Please use the following endpoint for a POST to https://app.procore.com/rest/v1.0/projects/{project_id}/timesheets for creating a timesheet and a POST to https://app.procore.com/rest/v1.1/projects/{project_id}/project_timecard_entries/bulk_create for creating timecard entries

200.description: Returns created Timesheet and Timecard Entries

status.description: The approval status of the Timesheet

hours.description: Total number of hours the resource was on sight.

equipment_timecard_entries.description: Equipment timecard entries associated with this timesheet.

client_local_id.description: Client-provided local identifier echoed in API responses for request/response correlation.

crew_id.description: ID of the crew the equipment timecard entry is associated with.

created_at.description: The date and time the equipment timecard entry was created.

created_by_id.description: ID of the user who created the equipment timecard entry.

date.description: The date for the equipment timecard entry.

equipment_id.description: Id of the equipment the equipment timecard entry is associated with.

location_id.description: ID of the location the equipment timecard entry is associated with.

party_id.description: ID of the party the equipment timecard entry is associated with (ie, operator).

project_id.description: ID of the project the equipment timecard entry is associated with.

quantity.description: Total number of hours/days/weeks the equipment was on site.

idle_quantity.description: Total number of hours/days/weeks the equipment was idle on site.

timesheet_id.description: ID of the timesheet the equipment timecard entry is associated with.

unit_of_measure.description: Enum that represents the unit of measure for provided quantity.

updated_at.description: The date and time the equipment timecard entry was last updated.

wbs_code_id.description: ID of the WBS code, the equipment timecard entry is associated with.

403.description: User does not have standard or abover permission to the Timesheets tool

404.description: There was a Project that could not be found

hours.description: Total number of hours worked (excluding breaks) for the timecard entry. This property is not required if the timesheet time entry is configured for start time and stop time.

lunch_time.description: The duration of the lunch break, in minutes, for the Timecard Entry. This property is only required if the timesheet time entry is configured for start time and stop time.

time_in.description: The start time of the Timecard Entry in ISO 8601 format. This property is only required if the timesheet time entry is configured for start time and stop time.

time_out.description: The stop time of the Timecard Entry in ISO 8601 format. This property is only required if the timesheet time entry is configured for start time and stop time.

billable.description: The billable status of the Timecard Entry. Must be either true or false.

date.description: The date of the Timecard Entry in ISO 8601 format.

description.description: The description of the Timecard Entry.

timecard_time_type_id.description: The ID of the Timecard Time Type corresponding to the Timecard Entry property.

timesheet_id.description: The ID of the Timesheet corresponding to the Timecard Entry property.

cost_code_id.description: The ID of the Cost Code corresponding to the Timecard Entry property.

sub_job_id.description: The ID of the Subjob corresponding to the Timecard Entry property.

location_id.description: The ID of the Location corresponding to the Timecard Entry property.

login_information_id.description: The ID of the Login Information corresponding to the Timecard Entry property.

party_id.description: The ID of the Party corresponding to the Timecard Entry property.

origin_id.description: The ID of the related external data.

origin_data.description: The value of the related external data.

line_item_type_id.description: The ID of the line item type corresponding to the time card entry.

wbs_code_id.description: The ID of the wbs code corresponding to the Timecard entry.
